'''Sharb''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sharb system/Legends|Sharb system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Path of the Houses]] linked it to the [[Noris system/Legends|Noris]] and [[Ornfra system/Legends|Ornfra systems]]. An outlying colony of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Sharb was home to one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss.<ref name="TEA" />

At some point by [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], the Ruling Family of Sharb employed hives of the sentient [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] as a work force. As a result, the Family fell out of power that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and became a casualty of a [[Chiss civil conflict|civil conflict]] against rival Ruling Families over the former's continued reliance on the Killiks.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sharb was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
